# Public Assets Folder

This folder contains all static assets for the NA Threads Manufacturing Industry website.

## Folder Structure

```
public/
├── favicon.ico                    # Website favicon
├── images/
│   ├── company/
│   │   └── 892ab86a-6dff-4030-8254-fccff10d90b1.png  # Company logo
│   ├── manufacturing/
│   │   └── factory.jpg           # Factory/manufacturing equipment images
│   └── products/
│       ├── button.png            # VT3 Buttons product image
│       ├── buttons.png           # VT3 Buttons product image
│       ├── drawcord.png          # Drawcords product image
│       ├── drawcords.png         # Drawcords product image
│       ├── thread1.jpg           # Sewing threads product image
│       ├── thread 2.jpg          # Sewing threads product image
│       ├── zip.png               # Zips product image
│       └── zips.png              # Zips product image
└── README.md                     # This file
```

## Image Requirements

### Logo (892ab86a-6dff-4030-8254-fccff10d90b1.png)
- **Size:** 978KB PNG file
- **Format:** PNG with transparent background
- **Content:** NA THREADS MANUFACTURING INDUSTRY logo with gold and navy blue colors

### Manufacturing Images
- **Size:** 1200x800px recommended
- **Format:** JPG or PNG
- **Content:** Modern textile manufacturing machinery, thread production equipment

### Product Images
- **Drawcords:** drawcord.png (2.8MB), drawcords.png (2.3MB)
- **Zips:** zip.png (2.2MB), zips.png (3.3MB)
- **VT3 Buttons:** buttons.png (1.8MB), button.png (2.5MB)
- **Sewing Threads:** thread1.jpg (119KB), thread 2.jpg (212KB)
- **Format:** PNG and JPG
- **Content:** High-quality thread products, manufacturing processes

### Favicon
- **Size:** 16x16, 32x32, or 48x48px
- **Format:** ICO file
- **Content:** Simplified version of the company logo

## Usage

Images in this folder are served directly by the web server and can be referenced in the code using absolute paths starting with `/`:

- Logo: `/images/company/892ab86a-6dff-4030-8254-fccff10d90b1.png`
- Factory image: `/images/manufacturing/factory.jpg`
- Product images: `/images/products/` (various PNG and JPG files)

## Notes

- Replace placeholder files with actual images
- Optimize images for web use (compress JPGs, optimize PNGs)
- Ensure all images have appropriate alt text in the code
- Consider creating multiple sizes for responsive design
